abstract: Treatment of choriocarcinoma should be eradicated of trophoblastic cells which undergo destruction in both of primary and metastatic sites and Methotrexate (MTX) has a most effective value. While MTX is being administration to the patients, there is no determination of clear relationship between proliferation of trophoblastic cells and production of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). In this report, we attempted to clarify the changes of the dividing compartments in cell cycle of human choriocarcinoma in vitro in the administration of MTX (concentration in 5 x 10(-6) M and 5 x 10(-7) M) to the experimental cells. Cell samples were stained by propidium iodide (PI) and fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC), then were measured nucleic acid and protein content by means of flow microfluorometry (FMF). MTX was remarkably increased the intensity of FITC associated with protein production, in dose that is not only killing effect to the cells but inhibition of DNA synthesis. Moreover, the most difference in both subjects were as follows; Ever when MTX in low concentration was removed after 48 hours, 50% of experimental cells recovered to the level of controls in contrast to the persistence of remarkable inhibition of DNA synthesis in high concentration.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌の治療では、原発巣と転移巣の両方で栄養膜細胞を根絶する必要があり、メトトレキサート(MTX)が最も有効である。MTX投与中の栄養膜細胞の増殖とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生との明確な関係は確認されていない。本報告では、培養ヒト絨毛癌細胞にMTX(5×10^-6 Mおよび5×10^-7 M)を投与し、in vitroでの細胞周期の分裂区画の変化を検討した。細胞をヨウ化プロピジウム(PI)およびフルオレセインイソチオシアネート(FITC)で染色し、フローサイトメトリーで核酸およびタンパク質含量を測定した。MTXは、細胞殺傷作用とDNA合成阻害をもたらす用量において、タンパク質産生に関連するFITCの蛍光強度を著明に増加させた。両群で最も差がみられた点は次のとおりである。低濃度のMTXを48時間後に除去しても、実験細胞の50%は対照群のレベルまで回復したが、高濃度ではDNA合成の著明な阻害が持続した。
